t0405-01.gloss: Field residue and response material share one ambiguous bundle.
t0405-01.rival_reading: Field workers and emergency responders could each have made this mixed bundle; it does not settle which activity came first.

t0405-02.gloss: A measured perimeter was laid out around the vans.
t0405-02.rival_reading: Field workers could mark out a treated plot the same way; the lengths alone do not say what was fenced in.
